subtitle: Lesson 16 · Model Serving and Inference Infrastructure

code:
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        workload-type: gpu-inference
      containers:
        - name: triton
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /v2/health/ready, port: 8000 }
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
          resources:
            limits:
              nvidia.com/gpu: 1
caption: 60s initialDelaySeconds — model loading into VRAM is not a 5-second startup.

code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: { name: model-server }
spec:
  selector: { app: model-server }
  ports: [{ port: 80, targetPort: 8000 }]
---
kind: Ingress
spec:
  rules:
    - host: inference.internal.example.com
      http:
        paths: [{ path: /, backend: { service: { name: model-server } } }]
caption: Nothing GPU-specific here — same routing, pointed at a GPU-backed Deployment.
